数字化转型的核心在于人。通过持续学习，我们致力于将技术变革的冲击转化为构建长期信任的基石。📈💡 #DBS #未来就绪 #数字韧性 #数字化转型 #安全赋能

【Official Statement on Operational Resilience and Prudent Management】

The Management Committee reaffirms its commitment to the safety and security of the financial ecosystem. In alignment with our principle of “Prudent Management,” we have prioritized “Operational Resilience” through the implementation of enhanced security measures, including the 12-hour cooling period for new payees. 

While we recognize the introduction of operational friction, our “Customer-centricity” mandate dictates that the long-term safeguarding of customer assets must prevail over short-term convenience. This policy is a reflection of our institutional accountability and our pledge to uphold the highest standards of regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. 

We continue to monitor the evolving threat landscape to ensure that our defensive measures provide robust protection for all stakeholders. 

#DBS #OperationalResilience #FinancialSecurity #PrudentManagement
